name: Bulbasaur

atk.x: Search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

fl: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo

atk.x: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

fl: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

name: Morelull

atk.x: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

fl: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

name: Charmander

atk.x: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

fl: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charizard

atk.x: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

fl: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

name: Arcanine

ab.x: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

fl: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

name: Psyduck

atk.x: This Pokémon is now Confused.

fl: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Magikarp

atk.x: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

fl: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

name: Greninja

atk.x: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

ab.x: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

fl: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Detective Pikachu

atk.x: Your opponent reveals their hand.
Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

name: Mr. Mime

atk.x: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

ab.x: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch 1 of your face-down Prize cards with the top card of your deck.

fl: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Mewtwo

atk.x: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.
Discard 2 Psychic Energy from this Pokémon.

fl: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Machamp

atk.x: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

fl: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

name: Jigglypuff

atk.x: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

fl: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Snubbull

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

fl: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Lickitung

atk.x: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

fl: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Ditto

atk.x: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. If this Pokémon doesn't have the necessary Energy to use that attack, this attack does nothing.

fl: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

name: Slaking

atk.x: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

fl: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.
